organizations.name: Concord Standards Bureau
organizations.role: Maintains widely adopted freight, docking, cargo identification and interoperability standards.
organizations.character: Boring by design and enormously influential because almost everyone benefits when containers, couplings and manifests agree.

organizations.name: Roosevelt Independent Yards Cooperative
organizations.role: Shared procurement, tug operations and certification services for several otherwise competing independent yards.
organizations.character: Pragmatic and manufacturer-agnostic; a major reason mixed-origin commercial ships are easy to build at New Houston.

organizations.name: Kesh Heavy Systems
organizations.role: Pressure vessels, structural members, reactors and industrial machinery.
organizations.character: Products are expensive, heavy and routinely remain in service long after cheaper competitors are scrapped.

organizations.name: Ilyan Vector Works
organizations.role: Commercial propulsion, maneuvering systems and lightweight drive structures.
organizations.character: Known for excellent efficiency and unforgiving installation tolerances.

organizations.name: Vey Closed Cycle
organizations.role: Life support, water recovery, atmosphere processing and closed-loop environmental systems.
organizations.character: Its equipment is common enough that crews often use the company name generically for water-recovery units.

organizations.name: Orun Thermal Collective
organizations.role: Heat exchangers, radiators, industrial cooling and compact thermal systems.
organizations.character: Equipment favors service access and replaceable subassemblies over clean exterior packaging.

organizations.name: Meridian Recovery & Salvage
organizations.role: Towing, derelict recovery, cargo salvage and distressed-vessel purchase.
organizations.character: Their tugs are often the last commercial ships outbound crews want to see and the first they are grateful to see.

organizations.name: Lastlight Survey Office
organizations.role: Registers survey plans, consolidates public navigation observations and purchases selected survey datasets.
organizations.character: Small office with responsibilities far larger than its staff.

organizations.name: Hesperus Producers Exchange
organizations.role: Coordinates agricultural storage, export auctions and seasonal freight allocations.
organizations.character: Its harvest forecasts can move freight prices several systems away.

organizations.name: Bradbury Institute Consortium
organizations.role: Shared laboratories, observatories, grants and high-security scientific logistics.
organizations.character: Academically competitive internally but unified when negotiating freight and infrastructure.
